description: Multi-Agent swarm architecture for automated ingestion, profiling, smart framing, and AMOLED optimization of smartwatch wallpapers.

coordinator.responsibility: Orchestrates user workflow, passes jobs to pipeline agents, monitors deliverables, and handles final GitHub publishing.

profiler.responsibility: Device catalog, resolutions, aspect ratios, panel types, and UI clock safe zone constraints.

ingester.responsibility: Image acquisition from web URLs, Steam workshop, and local files; raster standardizing to RGB.

cropper.responsibility: Rule-of-thirds smart vertical bias, aspect ratio framing, and Lanczos high-order resampling.

enhancer.responsibility: Smoothstep AMOLED black crush (#000000), contrast, vibrancy, micro-clarity unsharp mask, and 4:4:4 chroma export.

monitor.responsibility: Board activity monitor ensuring zero task deadlocks and timely delivery.
